L375: cite3†Back to top L376: # The Open-source Framework for Dataset Validationcite350†¶ L377: 
L378: > Data validation for scientists, engineers, and analysts seeking correctness.
L379: 
L380: Pandera is a cite351†Union.ai†union.ai open source project that provides a flexible and expressive API for performing data validation on dataframe-like objects. The goal of Pandera is to make data processing pipelines more readable and robust with statistically typed dataframes.
L381: Dataframes contain information that `pandera` explicitly validates at runtime. This is useful in production-critical data pipelines or reproducible research settings. With `pandera`, you can:
L382:   1. Define a schema once and use it to validate cite352†different dataframe types including cite353†pandas†pandas.pydata.org , cite354†polars†docs.pola.rs , cite355†dask†dask.org , cite356†modin†modin.readthedocs.io , cite357†ibis†ibis-project.org , and cite358†pyspark†spark.apache.org . Use the cite359†Narwhals-powered backend to keep validation fully lazy when possible.
L383: 
L384:   2. cite360†Check the types and properties of columns in a `pd.DataFrame` or values in a `pd.Series`.
L385:   3. Perform more complex statistical validation like cite361†hypothesis testing .
L386: 
L387:   4. cite362†Parse data to standardize the preprocessing steps needed to produce valid data.
L388: 
L389:   5. Seamlessly integrate with existing data analysis/processing pipelines via cite363†function decorators .
L390: 
L391:   6. Define dataframe models with the cite364†class-based API with pydantic-style syntax and validate dataframes using the typing syntax.
L392:   7. cite365†Synthesize data from schema objects for property-based testing with pandas data structures.
L393: 
L394:   8. cite366†Lazily Validate dataframes so that all validation rules are executed before raising an error.
L395: 
L396:   9. cite367†Integrate with a rich ecosystem of python tools like cite368†pydantic†pydantic-docs.helpmanual.io , cite369†fastapi†fastapi.tiangolo.com and cite370†mypy†mypy-lang.org .
